en: Your privacy matters to us. Read our Privacy Policy to learn how we protect your information.
tl: Mahalaga sa amin ang iyong privacy. Basahin ang aming Patakaran sa Privacy.

en:
DAPE-MA may collect account details, learning activity, bookmarks, device information, and feedback you submit so we can deliver content, improve services, and support your recovery journey.

We use this information to personalize your experience, send relevant updates, and keep the platform secure. We do not sell your personal data.

You may request access, correction, or deletion of your information, and you may withdraw consent where applicable. Educational content is intended for guidance and should be used with appropriate professional or parental support when needed.

For privacy concerns, contact info@ddb.gov.ph.
tl:
Maaaring mangolekta ang DAPE-MA ng detalye ng account, aktibidad sa pag-aaral, bookmark, impormasyon ng device, at feedback upang makapaghatid ng nilalaman at mapabuti ang serbisyo.

Ginagamit namin ang impormasyong ito para sa mas angkop na karanasan, mga update, at seguridad. Hindi namin ibinebenta ang iyong personal na data.

Maaari kang humiling ng access, pagwawasto, o pagbura ng iyong impormasyon. Para sa mga concern sa privacy, makipag-ugnayan sa info@ddb.gov.ph.

en: Read the terms and conditions for using the DAPE-MA application.
tl: Basahin ang mga tuntunin at kundisyon sa paggamit ng DAPE-MA.

en:
By using DAPE-MA, you agree to use the app responsibly and lawfully. Do not misuse content, attempt unauthorized access, copy or modify the application, or submit harmful or false information.

Content is provided for information and education. It does not replace professional medical, legal, or counseling advice.

We may update these Terms of Use from time to time. Continued use of the app after updates means you accept the revised terms.

For questions or concerns regarding these Terms of Use, please contact us at info@ddb.gov.ph.
tl:
Sa paggamit ng DAPE-MA, sumasang-ayon kang gamitin ang app nang responsable at ayon sa batas. Huwag abusuhin ang nilalaman o subukang mag-access nang walang pahintulot.

Ang nilalaman ay para sa impormasyon at edukasyon. Hindi ito kapalit ng propesyonal na payo.

Maaaring i-update ang mga Tuntunin. Ang patuloy na paggamit ay nangangahulugang tinatanggap mo ang mga pagbabago.

Para sa katanungan, makipag-ugnayan sa info@ddb.gov.ph.

en: Agreement for access to classified and sensitive information
tl: Kasunduan para sa access sa classified at sensitibong impormasyon

en: Please read the herein stated Agreement carefully and evidence your acceptance of its terms by clicking on the Agree button below:
tl: Pakibasa nang mabuti ang Kasunduang nakasaad dito at patunayan ang iyong pagtanggap sa mga tuntunin nito sa pamamagitan ng pag-click sa pindutang Agree sa ibaba:

en:
I hereby accept the obligations contained in this Agreement in consideration of my being granted access to classified and/or sensitive information under the Drug Abuse Prevention and Education Mobile Application (DAPE-MA). As used in this Agreement, classified information is referred to confidential information, including oral communications.

I understand and accept that by being granted access to classified information to the herein referred online system, the confidence and trust are placed in me by the Dangerous Drugs Board.

I understand that the DDB is the responsible agency in collecting all information submitted to the DAPE-MA by end-users.

I am fully aware that the data collection is for analysis and monitoring of reports and that the information gathered shall be used as basis for the development and improvement of policies and drug abuse prevention programs.

I acknowledge that the information generated from the DAPE-MA may be shared to other authorized organizations, partner agencies, local government units and other stakeholders for research, policy formulation and program development.

I agree that DDB shall immediately be notified if there are errors or discrepancies in the data being reported.

When notifying the DDB for possible security breaches, I shall include the following:
• Name and User ID
• Name of Agency/Organization/Facility
• Contact details
• Date and time of unauthorized access
• Description of security breach or fraud
• Description of error that has occurred.

I have been informed that unauthorized disclosure, unauthorized retention, or negligent handling of classified information by me could cause damage or irreparable injury to the Board and/or Government of the Philippines or could be used to advantage by other nation or people.

I hereby agree that I shall not divulge classified information to anyone unless:

• Officially verified that the recipient has been properly authorized by the Dangerous Drugs Board or by the government of the Philippines to receive it;
• I have been given prior written notice of authorization from the Dangerous Drugs Board responsible for the classified information, or granting me clearance that such disclosure is permitted;
• I have confirmed from an authorized official that the information is unclassified before I may disclose it.

I am obligated to comply with laws and regulations that prohibit the unauthorized disclosure of classified information.

By my (i) use and/or continued use of this Website, or (ii) access and use of the service provided through this Website, I signify my agreement to indemnify and to keep the DDB, its directors, employees fully and effectively indemnified against all actions, liabilities, costs, claims, losses, damages, proceedings and/or expenses (including all legal costs on an indemnity basis) without prejudice to the filing of any criminal case for violation of any statute or law.

Violation of any of the provisions of this agreement shall constitute breach and shall terminate this agreement immediately without need of notice, without prejudice to criminal prosecution for violation of RA 10173 otherwise known as the “Data Privacy Act of 2012,” as well as other pertinent laws.

Unless and until I am released in writing that all conditions and obligations imposed upon me by this Agreement applies during the time I am granted access to classified information and at all times thereafter.

Please accept to continue
tl:
Tinatanggap ko ang mga obligasyong nakapaloob sa Kasunduang ito bilang kapalit ng pagkakaloob sa akin ng access sa classified at/o sensitibong impormasyon sa ilalim ng Drug Abuse Prevention and Education Mobile Application (DAPE-MA). Sa Kasunduang ito, ang classified information ay tumutukoy sa kumpidensyal na impormasyon, kabilang ang mga oral na komunikasyon.

Nauunawaan at tinatanggap ko na sa pagkakaloob sa akin ng access sa classified information sa nabanggit na online system, inilalagak sa akin ng Dangerous Drugs Board ang kanilang tiwala.

Nauunawaan ko na ang DDB ang ahensyang responsable sa pagkolekta ng lahat ng impormasyong isinusumite sa DAPE-MA ng mga end-user.

Batid ko na ang pagkolekta ng datos ay para sa pagsusuri at pagsubaybay ng mga ulat, at gagamitin ang nakalap na impormasyon bilang batayan sa pagpapaunlad at pagpapabuti ng mga polisiya at programa sa pag-iwas sa pag-abuso sa droga.

Kinikilala ko na ang impormasyong nalilikha mula sa DAPE-MA ay maaaring ibahagi sa iba pang awtorisadong organisasyon, kasosyong ahensya, local government units, at iba pang stakeholder para sa pananaliksik, pagbuo ng polisiya, at pagpapaunlad ng programa.

Sumasang-ayon ako na agad na aabisuhan ang DDB kung may mga mali o hindi pagkakatugma sa datos na nire-report.

Kapag aabisuhan ang DDB ukol sa posibleng security breach, isasama ko ang mga sumusunod:
• Pangalan at User ID
• Pangalan ng Ahensya/Organisasyon/Pasilidad
• Detalye ng pakikipag-ugnayan
• Petsa at oras ng hindi awtorisadong pag-access
• Paglalarawan ng security breach o panloloko
• Paglalarawan ng naganap na error.

Naipaalam sa akin na ang hindi awtorisadong pagbunyag, hindi awtorisadong pagtatago, o pabayaang paghawak ko sa classified information ay maaaring magdulot ng pinsala o hindi na mababawi na injury sa Board at/o sa Pamahalaan ng Pilipinas, o magamit nang pabor ng ibang bansa o tao.

Sumasang-ayon ako na hindi ko ibubunyag ang classified information kaninuman maliban kung:

• Opisyal na napatunayan na ang tatanggap ay wastong pinahintulutan ng Dangerous Drugs Board o ng pamahalaan ng Pilipinas na tumanggap nito;
• Binigyan ako ng paunang nakasulat na paunawa ng awtorisasyon mula sa Dangerous Drugs Board na responsable sa classified information, o ng clearance na pinahihintulutan ang naturang pagbunyag;
• Nakumpirma ko mula sa awtorisadong opisyal na unclassified ang impormasyon bago ko ito maibunyag.

Obligado akong sumunod sa mga batas at regulasyong nagbabawal sa hindi awtorisadong pagbunyag ng classified information.

Sa aking (i) paggamit at/o patuloy na paggamit ng Website na ito, o (ii) access at paggamit ng serbisyong ibinibigay sa pamamagitan ng Website na ito, ipinapahayag ko ang aking pagsang-ayon na indemnify at panatilihing fully at effectively indemnified ang DDB, ang mga direktor, at empleyado nito laban sa lahat ng aksyon, pananagutan, gastos, claim, pagkawala, pinsala, proceedings, at/o gastusin (kabilang ang lahat ng legal na gastos on an indemnity basis), nang hindi isinasakripisyo ang paghahain ng anumang criminal case para sa paglabag sa anumang batas.

Ang paglabag sa alinmang probisyon ng kasunduang ito ay ituturing na breach at agad na magwawakas ang kasunduang ito nang hindi na kailangan ng paunawa, nang hindi isinasakripisyo ang criminal prosecution para sa paglabag sa RA 10173 na kilala rin bilang “Data Privacy Act of 2012,” at iba pang naaangkop na batas.

Hangga’t hindi ako pinalalaya sa pamamagitan ng sulat, ang lahat ng kundisyon at obligasyong ipinapataw sa akin ng Kasunduang ito ay nalalapat habang ako ay pinagkalooban ng access sa classified information at sa lahat ng panahon pagkatapos nito.

en: A daily motivational quote for a drug-free youth
tl: Araw-araw na motivational quote para sa drug-free youth

en: Choose courage over comfort. A drug-free life starts with one brave decision today.
tl: Piliin ang tapang kaysa ginhawa. Nagsisimula ang drug-free life sa isang matapang na desisyon ngayon.

en: Choose courage over comfort. A drug-free life starts with one brave decision today.
tl: Piliin ang tapang kaysa ginhawa. Nagsisimula ang drug-free life sa isang matapang na desisyon ngayon.

en: Sign in to keep your private daily journal.
tl: Mag-sign in para sa iyong pribadong journal.

en: No journal entries yet. Start writing to begin.
tl: Wala pang journal entry. Magsimulang sumulat para magsimula.

en: Add at least one reflection field before saving.
tl: Magdagdag muna ng kahit isang refleksiyon bago i-save.

en: This entry will be removed permanently.
tl: Permanenteng mabubura ang entry na ito.
Walang entry na tumutugma sa filter.

en: Pick the color that matches your inner world. Light tones are brighter moods; dark tones are heavier ones.
tl: Piliin ang kulay na tumutugma sa iyong loob. Ang maliwanag na tono ay mas magaan na damdamin; ang madilim ay mas mabigat.

en: Select all that apply — or add your own.
tl: Piliin ang lahat na angkop — o magdagdag ng sarili.
Ano ang humubog sa araw mo?

en: Choose the area that mattered most today.
tl: Piliin ang bahagi na pinakamahalaga ngayon.
May iba pa bang nais isulat?

en: Optional free notes — write as much or as little as you need.
tl: Opsyonal na notes — magkano man ang isulat mo.

en: {name}, what are you grateful for today?
Take a photo or choose from your library. We’ll optimize it before upload.
tl: Kumuha ng litrato o pumili mula sa gallery. Io-optimize bago i-upload.

en: Could not prepare that photo. Please try another.
tl: Hindi ma-prepare ang larawan. Subukan ang iba.

en: Together for a drug-free and hopeful future.
tl: Sama-sama para sa drug-free at may pag-asang kinabukasan.
Maghanap ng communities, events, at campaigns!

en: DAPE Learn is coming in Phase 2.
tl: Darating ang DAPE Learn sa Phase 2.

en: This is for you if you want to:
tl: Para sa iyo kung gusto mong:

en: Learn about drugs, life skills, and making informed decisions.
tl: Matuto tungkol sa drugs, life skills, at matalinong desisyon.

en: Connect, share, and support one another!
tl: Makipag-ugnayan, magbahagi, at suportahan ang isa’t isa!

en: Take care of your well-being and mental health.
tl: Alagaan ang iyong well-being at mental health.

en: Read inspiring stories and inspire others with yours.
tl: Magbasa ng inspirasyon at magbahagi ng iyong kwento.

en: Find help and resources when you or someone needs it.
tl: Maghanap ng tulong at resources kung kailangan.

en: Join events and activities in your community.
tl: Sumali sa mga event at aktibidad sa komunidad.
Tuklasin ang scholarships at career opportunities.

en: Be a voice for change through your own ways.
tl: Maging boses ng pagbabago sa iyong sariling paraan.
Naaasikaso mo nang maayos ang stress!

en: Everyone feels stressed sometimes. You're handling things well, but small self-care steps can help you stay balanced.
tl: Normal ang stress. Hinahawakan mo ito nang maayos, at makakatulong ang maliit na self-care para manatiling balanced.

en: Your stress may be affecting your well-being.
tl: Maaaring naaapektuhan ng stress ang well-being mo.

en: You're experiencing more stress than is ideal. It is important to take action and build healthier coping strategies.
tl: Mas mataas sa ideal ang stress mo. Mahalagang gumawa ng hakbang at magtayo ng mas healthy na paraan ng pagcope.

en: You may feel worried at times, but you're managing.
tl: May pag-aalala paminsan-minsan, pero nahahawakan mo.

en: Keep using the Calm Corner tools to maintain balance and prevent worries from building up.
tl: Ituloy ang Calm Corner para mapanatili ang balance at maiwasang magtumpok ang pag-aalala.

en: Your anxiety level may be affecting your well-being.
tl: Maaaring naaapektuhan ng anxiety ang well-being mo.

en: Try relaxation activities daily, journal your feelings, and use guided meditation to ease tension. Consider professional help if worries feel overwhelming.
tl: Subukan ang relaxation araw-araw, mag-journal, at gumamit ng guided meditation. Humingi ng propesyonal na tulong kung sobrang bigat ng pag-aalala.
Sapat at maganda ang tulog mo.

en: You have a consistent sleep routine and good sleep quality. Small improvements can make a big difference!
tl: Consistent ang routine at maganda ang tulog mo. Malaki ang epekto ng maliliit na pagbabago.
Pwede pang pagbutihin ang tulog mo.

en: You may not be getting enough restful sleep. Poor sleep can affect your mood, focus, and energy levels. Need help? Feel free to reach out.
tl: Maaaring kulang ang restful sleep mo. Nakakaapekto ito sa mood, focus, at energy. Kung kailangan mo ng tulong, mag-reach out.

en: This test is for self-reflection only and does not replace professional evaluation.
tl: Para sa self-reflection lamang ang test na ito at hindi kapalit ng propesyonal na ebalwasyon.

en: Could not save this check. Please try again.
tl: Hindi nai-save ang check. Subukan ulit.

en: Need a 2-minute reset? Use these tools before a quiz, after class, or anytime your mind feels busy.
tl: Kailangan ng 2-minutong pahinga? Gamitin bago ang quiz, pagkatapos ng klase, o kapag magulo ang isip.
Tapos na ang breathing break mo.
Tapos na ang calm break mo ngayon.

en: Notice how your body feels: lighter, calmer, more focused.
tl: Pansinin ang katawan: mas magaan, mas kalmado, mas focused.

en: Slow breathing helps lower stress, steady your focus, and calm your body — useful before exams or presentations.
tl: Ang mabagal na paghinga ay nagpapababa ng stress at tumutulong mag-focus — lalo na bago ang exam o recitation.

en: Press play. Follow the circle: breathe in as it grows, hold, then breathe out as it shrinks. Four rounds is enough.
tl: I-play. Huminga papasok habang lumalaki ang circle, pigilin, tapos huminga palabas habang lumiliit. Apat na round ay sapat.

en: Try this at your desk. No one needs to notice — just four quiet breaths.
tl: Pwede sa desk. Hindi kailangang mapansin ng iba — apat na tahimik na hinga.

en: A short, steady sound can take your mind off racing thoughts and give you a quiet minute between classes.
tl: Ang tahimik at steady na tunog ay nakakatulong kalmahin ang isip sa pagitan ng klase.

en: Press play, use earphones if you can, and breathe slowly. You can pause anytime.
tl: I-play, gumamit ng earphones kung maaari, at huminga nang dahan-dahan. Pwede i-pause anytime.

en: Keep the volume low. This is a break, not a playlist.
tl: Ibaba ang volume. Pahinga ito, hindi playlist.

en: A short pause helps clear your mind, reduce stress, and return to class with more focus.
tl: Ang maikling pause ay nakakatulong linawin ang isip at bumalik sa klase nang mas focused.

en: Press play, sit comfortably, and follow the words on the screen. You can pause anytime.
tl: I-play, umupo nang komportable, at sundan ang mga salita sa screen. Pwede i-pause anytime.

en: If a thought about homework appears, notice it and let it pass. That is normal.
tl: Kung may naiisip na assignment, pansinin at hayaan itong dumaan. Normal iyon.

en: Picturing a safe place can calm your body when you feel pressure from school, friends, or home.
tl: Ang pag-isip ng ligtas na lugar ay nakakakalma kapag may pressure sa school, kaibigan, o bahay.

en: Press play, close your eyes if you like, and follow the guided imagery. Pause anytime.
tl: I-play, ipikit ang mata kung gusto mo, at sundan ang guided imagery. Pwede i-pause anytime.

en: Pick a real place you know — your room, a court, the sea, or a quiet hallway.
tl: Pumili ng tunay na lugar na kilala mo — kwarto, court, dagat, o tahimik na hallway.

en: Sit comfortably. Rest your hands. Let your shoulders drop.
tl: Umupo nang komportable. Ihiga ang kamay. Ibaba ang balikat.

en: Notice your breath. You do not need to change it yet.
tl: Pansinin ang hinga. Hindi pa kailangang baguhin.

en: If a thought about school appears, name it, then return to your breath.
tl: Kung may naiisip na school, pangalanan, tapos bumalik sa hinga.

en: Take one slower breath. When you are ready, open your eyes.
tl: Kumuha ng mas mabagal na hinga. Kapag handa ka na, imulat ang mata.

en: Picture a place that feels safe — your room, a court, the sea, or a quiet hallway.
tl: Isipin ang lugar na ligtas para sa iyo — kwarto, court, dagat, o hallway.

en: Notice colors, sounds, and temperature. Make the scene feel real.
tl: Pansinin ang kulay, tunog, at temperatura. Gawing totoo ang eksena.

en: Imagine your body relaxing in that place. Unclench your jaw and hands.
tl: Isipin na nagre-relax ang katawan mo doon. Bitawan ang panga at kamay.

en: Take that calm with you. You can return here anytime you need a pause.
tl: Dalhin ang kalmado. Pwede kang bumalik dito anytime kailangan mo ng pause.

en: Gently tilt your right ear toward your shoulder. Keep breathing.
tl: Dahan-dahang i-tilt ang kanang tenga patungo sa balikat. Patuloy na huminga.

en: Roll both shoulders back slowly, then let them drop.
tl: I-roll pabalik ang dalawang balikat, tapos ibaba.

en: Reach both arms up, then fold forward over your desk or lap.
tl: Itaas ang dalawang braso, tapos yumuko pasulong sa desk o kandungan.
